subcategory_descriptions.chapter_output_existence: 工作区至少有一个章节文件产出
subcategory_descriptions.chapter_cloning: 没有连续≥2章内容完全克隆(MD5比对)
subcategory_descriptions.alternating_repetition: 后半部分没有≥3轮A-B交替循环
subcategory_descriptions.chapter_completion: 实际章节数≥大纲规划的30%
subcategory_descriptions.character_design_adherence: 角色实际表现符合characters.json设计
subcategory_descriptions.dialogue_character_distinction: 遮住名字还能分辨谁在说话
subcategory_descriptions.narrative_density: 有场景描写/感官细节/心理活动,不是流水账
subcategory_descriptions.genre_fit: 题材特征有深度而非流于表面
subcategory_descriptions.outline_execution_fidelity: 正文忠实于自己设计的大纲
subcategory_descriptions.structural_logic_defect: 无时间线矛盾/人物消失/世界观冲突
subcategory_descriptions.narrative_tone_match: 文笔风格和叙事语气与题材匹配
subcategory_descriptions.late_stage_digression: 后期没混入作者感想/读者互动/番外预告
subcategory_descriptions.repeated_endings: 全文只有一个结局,没有反复出现全文完
subcategory_descriptions.paragraph_repetition: 相邻段落没有大面积重复
subcategory_descriptions.full_narrative_content: 输出的是完整叙事正文而非大纲/摘要
subcategory_descriptions.plot_progression: 情节有推进而非原地踏步
subcategory_descriptions.fixable_logic_inconsistency: 无可修复的逻辑小瑕疵
subcategory_descriptions.semantic_redundancy: 后续章节没有语义层面大量重复前文
subcategory_descriptions.pacing_rationality_advanced: 起承转合节奏自然,有铺垫有高潮有收束
subcategory_descriptions.hook_design: 关键转折处有具体悬念钩子
subcategory_descriptions.imagery_system: 有反复出现且含义随剧情变化的意象
subcategory_descriptions.structural_design: 叙事结构有设计感(首尾呼应/视角切换等)
subcategory_descriptions.emotional_gradient: 主角情感有≥4层变化,由事件驱动
subcategory_descriptions.emotional_delivery_match: 情感交付到位(虐文真虐/甜文真甜)
subcategory_descriptions.required_skill_reading: 动手写之前读了写作指南等skill文件
subcategory_descriptions.sop_compliance: 按规定流程走:配方选择→准备确认→再动笔
subcategory_descriptions.log_file_usage: 写作过程中读取log了解前文
subcategory_descriptions.range_constraint: 每章字数在规定范围内
subcategory_descriptions.quantity_constraint: 标签数量等数值约束达标
subcategory_descriptions.enum_validity: 选项值在允许的枚举列表内
subcategory_descriptions.output_completeness: 所有必需输出文件都已产出
subcategory_descriptions.structural_integrity: 目录结构和文件命名规范
subcategory_descriptions.naming_convention: 文件/变量命名符合规范
subcategory_descriptions.character_trait_consistency: 角色性格特征前后一致
subcategory_descriptions.character_naming_quality: 角色命名质量(仅展示不计分)
subcategory_descriptions.character_presence_in_chapters: 设定角色在正文中出场
subcategory_descriptions.character_presence_in_outline: 设定角色在大纲中出现
